definitions.explanation: Extremely large in size, scale, or extent.

examples.japanese: {巨大|きょだい}な⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I can see a huge building.

examples.japanese: {巨大|きょだい}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支配|しはい}している→支配：01421_shihai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{巨大|きょだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: This tree grew to an enormous size.

notes:
Stronger than ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: size far beyond the normal scale, for physical things (buildings, animals, waves) and abstract ones (organizations, influence, markets).

FORMS:
- {巨大|きょだい}な + noun: huge ~
- {巨大|きょだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: enormously ({巨大|きょだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧)
- ⟦{巨大化|きょだいか}→巨大化：26010_kyodaika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to grow enormous

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巨大|きょだい}な⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧ / ⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: enormous power / influence
- {巨大|きょだい}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: giant corporation
- {巨大|きょだい}⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧: massive earthquake
- {巨大|きょだい}な⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧: a huge typhoon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{膨大|ぼうだい}→膨大：08997_boudai⟧: enormous, mostly of amounts and data
- ⟦{莫大|ばくだい}→莫大：03700_bakudai⟧: immense, mostly of money and abstract quantities
- ⟦{壮大|そうだい}→壮大：10900_soudai⟧: grand, magnificent; adds grandeur rather than size
